articles.title: A 1920-era American elm survived a 4,000-pound bomb in Oklahoma City
articles.summary: An American elm in Oklahoma City known as the Survivor Tree has observed many changes since its likely planting in 1920. The tree was growing in a family backyard before commercial development removed surrounding trees and structures.

3,000-year-old horse buried inside ancient Egyptian fortress may have been a chariot animal
articles.summary: Archaeologists have uncovered the remains of a 3,000-year-old young male horse inside Egypt’s ancient Abqaa’ fortress, suggesting it may have been used to pull a chariot. Nearby harness fittings point to its military role.

articles.title: In 2021, Georgia police destroyed $37,000 hemp; 6 years later, Supreme Court revives grower’s claim
articles.summary: In 2021, Georgia police aircraft allegedly destroyed $37,000 worth of legally grown hemp during a drug-suppression operation. Six years later, the Georgia Supreme Court revived the grower’s compensation claim, overturning a 60-year-old precedent that broadly shielded government agencies from property-damage claims when acting under police powers.

articles.title: Shah Rukh Khan took personal responsibility for my career: Abhishek Bachchan
articles.summary: Abhishek Bachchan has opened up about his upcoming film King with Shah Rukh Khan, calling it his favourite project at present. In a conversation with BBC, Abhishek described SRK as an “elder brother” and revealed that the superstar has repeatedly taken “personal responsibility” for his career, including with King.

articles.title: Second baby on the way: Kiara Advani, Sidharth expecting again
articles.summary: Kiara Advani and Sidharth Malhotra are expecting their second child. Kiara shared a photo of daughter Saraayah holding a tiny white sock, captioned "Blessed once again with the greatest gift of all." The couple, who bonded on Shershaah, married in Jaisalmer in February 2023 and welcomed Saraayah in July 2025..
